versions.content: Ability to return more detailed invalid value information about received structured dataElement The configuration of attribute Recep- tionComSpecProps.invalidValueBitfieldErrorsEnabled allows for the ex- tension of RTE APIs related to the referenced dataElement in the context of the enclosing PortPrototype , such that information about invalid value errors can be retrieved for every individual sub-element of the referenced structured dataElement .
